At eighty-six, I cannot bend over this plot like I used to, so my family will do most of the work while I watch and advise them. I will put fertilizer on this maize because without it the soil in Ntchisi gives nothing, and I will use the improved seed from last season. We wait for the rains and do not irrigate here. I will need to hire some young men from the village for a few days when the ridging and harvesting are hard.
